items: The Response Gap, the time between a guest voicing dissatisfaction and your brand responding, is a visible sign of how well a store is run.
High-performing stores can absorb mistakes, while slow replies speed the decline of underperforming stores as unhappy guests move to competitors.
Treat response time as an operational metric: acknowledge feedback within minutes, surface recurring issues automatically and send managers prioritized mobile alerts.
Closing the Response Gap is often the fastest operational fix you have, since it needs discipline and automation more than new spend.
